pilot: one finite-grid run, N24 L32 T400 seed17, all numerical budgets passed
reason: Ideal point solutes coupled linearly to an unbounded composition field have no excluded-volume pressure. Despite finite-grid boundedness, the continuum free energy can run to minus infinity under concentration collapse. A density picture from this model cannot establish a physically resolved vessel.
scaling_argument: In 3D choose phi=A/R f(x/R), total solute mass m in radius R. Gradient, quartic and attraction terms scale as [C2*kappa*A^2+C4*beta*A^4-C1*chi*m*A]/R. For sufficiently small positive A the coefficient is negative. Ideal entropy only grows logarithmically in 1/R. Material mean is compensated by an O(R^2) uniform shift. Hence F has no continuum lower bound.
consequence: Retain the pilot and original model unchanged. No claim of an honest material container or life precursor is counted. Introduce excluded-volume repulsion only in a separately preregistered law variant from t=0.
